text: {"differences": [{"reason": "English entity \"Federal Chancellor's staff office\" corresponds to French \"L’état-major du chancelier de la Confédération\", but the French text adds that it supports the Chancellor and Vice-Chancellors, which is not in the English text.", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "The task of the [entity] is to ensure the cross-departmental coordination of projects, resources and administrative services to advance the digital transformation process within the Federal Administration.", "before": ""}, "tgt": {"quote": "Il assure la coordination interdépartementale des projets, des moyens et des prestations administratives dans la perspective de la transformation numérique de l’administration fédérale.", "before": ""}, "severity": 0.6}, {"reason": "English entity \"Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner\" corresponds to French \"Préposé fédéral à la protection des données et à la transparence\", but the French claim refers to \"loi fédérale sur le principe de la transparence\" (Federal Act on the Principle of Transparency), while the English claim refers to \"Federal Act on Freedom of Information in the Administration\".", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "The [entity] has two areas of responsibility: the Federal Act on Data Protection and the Federal Act on Freedom of Information in the Administration.", "before": "entity:"}, "tgt": {"quote": "Le exerce ses compétences dans les domaines de la loi fédérale sur la protection des données et de la loi fédérale sur le principe de la transparence dans l'administration.", "before": "entity:"}, "severity": 0.8}]}
